description.value: Abadan is a family-run restaurant bringing authentic Southern Iranian street food to North Vancouver's Marine Drive, founded by a family originally from Abadan, Iran, who recreated a piece of their hometown complete with traditional décor and ethnic goods. The menu centres on falafels, samosas, tandoori sandwiches, seafood, and traditional breakfast dishes like kale pache, with a strong emphasis on vegan-friendly options. Both dine-in and takeout are available, with delivery through Ubereats and Doordash.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at abadan.ca is fully fetched and confirms an active Southern Iranian fast food restaurant at 1431 Marine Drive, North Vancouver, with phone (778) 504 2004 and email info@abadan.ca visible on every page — OSM listed no phone, so the phone value comes from the website only. Vegan and vegetarian options are explicitly confirmed in the FAQ ('Our falafels are 100% vegan') and a dedicated 'Vegan Items' homepage section; takeout is confirmed via in-store ordering and Ubereats/Doordash delivery partnerships. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific infrastructure anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM tags this as 'amenity=cafe' but the website consistently refers to it as 'Abadan Fast Food' — it operates as a casual fast-food/lounge, not a café. Food & Drink category is still appropriate.
OSM had no phone number; (778) 504-2004 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
Website displays postal code as 'V7P1T 5' — appears to be a formatting artefact for V7P 1T5.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed open via a fully fetched website with consistent contact details; a viable food stop for cyclists on Marine Drive in North Vancouver.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website FAQ: 'Our falafels are 100% vegan, made with chickpeas, herbs, and spices'; vegan wraps with grilled veggies, hummus, and tahini also offered; dedicated 'Vegan Items' homepage section; veggie samosa on menu. No GF claims found
